title: Cellular $\mathbb{A}^1$-Homology from Bruhat Boundary Matrices of Split Semisimple Flag Varieties
summary: Let $k$ be a perfect field of characteristic different from 2, we compute the cellular $\mathbb{A}^1$-homology of the flag varieties $G/P_Θ$ attached to split semisimple simply connected groups over $k$ and describe the differentials in the cellular $\mathbb{A}^1$-chain complex concretely. The construction applies uniformly to the type $A$ coefficient formula, to the type $B_n,C_n,D_n$ for $n\leq 7$, and to the exceptional types for $F_4,E_6,E_7$.
